name: R_HEALTHCARE_PHI_MRN_ACCT_DOB
description: Inline Web DLP: PHI presence (E_HEALTHCARE_PHI) or bulk export (E_PHI_BULK_EXPORT). Monitor-only to start; OCR on so screenshots and scanned PDFs are inspected; 10 KB floor suppresses small-telemetry false positives. Move to BLOCK after tuning.

name: R_PHI_SSL_DECRYPT_FILE_SHARE_WEBMAIL_AI
description: SSL Inspection: decrypt traffic to file-sharing, webmail and AI/ML applications so the DLP rule can inspect HTTPS uploads. Without this, content inspection never sees the payload. Applications are resolved from the tenant catalogue at deploy time.

name: R_PHI_CAC_FILE_SHARE_NO_UPLOAD
description: Cloud App Control: on file-sharing applications, allow viewing and downloading but block upload and share. Stops bulk exports to personal cloud storage before content inspection is needed. Actions are chosen from the tenant's available actions for each application.

name: R_PHI_CAC_WEBMAIL_NO_SEND
description: Cloud App Control: on personal webmail (Gmail, Yahoo, ...), allow reading but block sending and attachments.

name: R_PHI_CAC_AI_NO_UPLOAD
description: Cloud App Control: on AI & ML applications (ChatGPT and similar), allow browsing but block upload and file submission.

name: R_PHI_FTC_BLOCK_BULK_EXPORT_UPLOAD
description: File Type Control: block upload of spreadsheets, databases and archives to file-sharing applications. These are the bulk-export formats where DLP byte proximity is least reliable. Adjust file_types to the category names your tenant shows under Administration > File Type Control.

name: R_PHI_FTC_CAUTION_IMAGE_UPLOAD
description: File Type Control: caution on image uploads (screenshots, photographed records) to file-sharing applications. Images bypass text-based dictionaries; the DLP rule's OCR covers what you allow through.

name: R_PHI_URL_BLOCK_POST_TO_UNKNOWN
description: URL Filtering: block POST/PUT (uploads and form submissions) to uncategorised and gambling sites. Closes the unknown-destination channel; adjust url_categories to your tenant's category names.
